p: shall eat among all the beasts: Or, of which ye may eat.

hoof: He notes four types of beasts, some that chew the cud only, and some that only have the hoof cleft. Others neither chew the cud, nor have the hoof cleft, and the fourth both chew the cud and have the hoof divided, which may be eaten.
flesh shall ye not eat: God would that by this for a time they should be discerned as his people from the Gentiles.
move in the waters: As little fish begotten in the slime.
living thing which is in the: As they which come of generation.
bald locust after his kind: These were certain types of grasshoppers, which are not now properly known.
beareth ought of the carcase of: Out of the camp.
tortoise after his kind: The green frog that sits on the bushes.
skin: As a bottle or bag.
toucheth their carcase shall be unclean: So much of the water as touched it.
water be put upon the seed: He speaks of seed that is laid to sleep before it is sown.
holy: He shows why God chose them to be his people, 1Pe 1:15.
